title: Organizations
summary: The organizations you belong to, as a section of their own.

requirements.text: The main navigation has an Orgs section after Repos, for signed-in users. Guests don't have it.
It lists the organizations the user belongs to, each with its name (or its login when it has none), description and number of repositories.
An organization opens its page, with its repositories.
The list is loaded at startup, so opening the section doesn't wait.
With more than eight organizations the list can be filtered by name, login and description.
On a desktop, Cmd or Ctrl+2 opens the section; the user's profile moves to 3.

questions: Organizations that restrict third-party apps don't show up until they approve this one. Should the page say so, with a link to request access?
